message.content:
Below is a list of **federal public‑holiday long weekends** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
(Provincial holidays that create additional long weekends are not included here; let me know if you’d like those as well.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Weekend Days Included |
|---------|-------------|-----------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sunday) – observed Mon 2 | Dec 30–31 (Fri‑Sun) + Jan 1–2 (Mon‑Tue) |
| Family Day (BC, AB, ON, SK, NB, PE) | Feb 20 (Monday) | Feb 18–20 (Sat‑Mon) |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Friday) | Apr 7–9 (Fri‑Sun) |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Monday) | May 20–22 (Sat‑Mon) |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Saturday) – observed Mon 3 | Jul 1–3 (Sat‑Mon) |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Monday) | Sep 2–4 (Sat‑Mon) |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 (Monday) | Oct 7–9 (Sat‑Mon) |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Saturday) – observed Fri 10 | Nov 10–12 (Fri‑Sun) |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Monday) | Dec 23–25 (Sat‑Mon) |

### Notes
- **Observance**: When a holiday falls on a weekend, it is often observed on the following weekday. This creates a longer stretch of consecutive days off.
- **Provincial Variations**: Some provinces observe additional holidays (e.g., Easter Monday in Ontario/Quebec, Civic Holiday in most provinces, etc.) that can also form long weekends. If you need those details, just let me know which province(s) you’re interested in!
